definitions.explanation: To disappear without a trace. Stronger and more emphatic than simply {消|き}える. Can also be used as a harsh command meaning 'get lost.'

examples.japanese: {希望|きぼう}が{消|き}え{失|う}せてしまった。
{夢|ゆめ}から{覚|さ}めると、さっきまでの{幸|しあわ}せな{気持|きも}ちが{消|き}え{失|う}せていた。
examples.english: When I woke from the dream, the happy feeling from moments ago had completely vanished.

notes: A compound verb from {消|き}える (to disappear) and {失|う}せる (to be lost/vanish). Emphasizes completeness of disappearance compared to {消|き}える alone. In imperative form ({消|き}え{失|う}せろ), it becomes a very harsh way to tell someone to get lost. Intransitive verb. Collocations: {痕跡|こんせき}が{消|き}え{失|う}せる (traces vanish), {不安|ふあん}が{消|き}え{失|う}せる (anxiety disappears).
